sources.title: GitHub - t04aiteam/qwen-translate-api: API for Qwen 3.5 text ...
sources.snippet: A FastAPI service for text translation and summarization, powered by unsloth/Qwen3.5-4B-GGUF running locally via llama-cpp-python. The quantised GGUF checkpoint (Qwen3.5-4B-Q4_K_M.gguf, ~2.5 GB) is downloaded from the Hugging Face Hub on first startup and cached under ~/.cache/huggingface.

sources.snippet: Quantization This model is created by quantizing Qwen/Qwen3.5-27B to Q4_K_M using convert_hf_to_gguf.py and llama-quantize from llama.cpp. Target Users This model supports CPU and heterogeneous (CPU+GPU) inference deployment, making it suitable for users without a GPU.
